summary: Native data contract declaration layer. A BaseDataContract subclass declares members as FieldDefinition objects and compiles to validation checks; Validator orchestrates conform, rule resolution and the validation engine, RuleRegistry handles context-aware rule applicability, and ValidationPlan runs several validators sequentially. Result types are re-exported from mountainash.validation.
key_classes: BaseDataContract — base class; FieldDefinition class members become the contract schema, with Config for name/coerce/natural_key/primary_key
Validator — binds contract, rules and data; validate() / validate_quick() (fail_fast)
Rule / ContextualRule — a named expression for data validation; guarded() wraps applicability
RuleRegistry — composable rule collection with context-aware gating
ValidationResultProcessor — failure-case analysis over the unified result schema
key_functions: compile_datacontract(schema: TableSchema) -> CompiledValidationPlan — compile checks from a schema
contract_from_table_schema(schema) -> type[BaseDataContract] — build a contract class
guarded(...) — attach applicability guard to a rule
extension_points: Rule / RuleRegistry for custom rules with applicability gating
datacontracts.result is a back-compat path; canonical types live in mountainash.validation
lifecycle_notes: Pandera removed: contracts are native (BaseDataContract docstring 'no Pandera').
7beed8cb: Validator acquires contract declarations at construction.
d16f47e5: fields_match modes and support columns documented on TypeSpec/Validator (132).
d7af5f05 and a68147b6 keep relation sampling deferred and remove transit policing.
documentation_hooks: Validating data with Validator and reading ValidationResult
Booleanizer / null-safety on rules (t_maybe_true is the ignore_na analog)
examples: class C(BaseDataContract): age: int = FieldDefinition(dtype=D.I64, minimum=0)
risks: Input is conformed to the contract before checks run; under default fields_match='exact' a column read by a rule but absent from the contract is rejected.
Contract edits after Validator construction do not affect existing Validators.
